Subject: Supplier portal invite failing — 403 on EU redirect

Hi Irene / Marissa,

We're trying to accept the supplier invite you sent for BlueBay Logistics (vendor onboarding for PO #BB-4421) but the invite link keeps returning a 403 page when it redirects to the EU tenant. The page shows a geo-restriction/403 (screenshot attached: error_403_geo.png).

- Open invite in Chrome (incognito)
- Clear cookies and try again
- Tried a different IP (home broadband) — same result

This is blocking our ability to upload tax docs ahead of the PO cutoff tomorrow. Can you advise a workaround or escalate?

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite failing — 403 on EU redirect

Hi all — I pulled the edge logs and trace for the invite flow (attached: server_redirect_trace.txt). Quick summary: the CDN edge is inserting a geo-allow header based on the incoming IP and then triggering a redirect to /eu/tenant/relaystate. On a subset of our older invite tokens, the relaystate contains an explicit region parameter and the downstream auth proxy drops X-Forwarded-For when it performs the redirect, causing the SAML request to be rejected with 403.

Root cause (short): legacy invite tokens with embedded region param + edge redirect + auth-proxy header drop = 403 for some EU-origin requests.

Temporary workaround (what I can do right now):
- Generate a "regionless" invite URL that omits region=eu and relies on tenant lookup after SAML (I created one and pasted it to invite_regionless_test.txt).
- That link should land on the tenant chooser/hand-off without triggering the problematic redirect rule.

Tom — please try the regionless URL (I resent it just now). If that succeeds, we'll:
1) Rotate the invite token for BlueBay so the onboarding flow completes.
2) Patch the auth-proxy to preserve forwarded headers on internal redirects (targeted patch and canary today).

I've opened RDW-9573 to track the infra fix: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-9573
Attaching trace: server_redirect_trace.txt (text/plain)

If the regionless link fails, please forward the exact 403 response body and the time you hit it and I'll correlate.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Platform Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
